refs_unused_idx.name: refs_unused_idx
refs_unused_idx.where: ((content_id IS NULL) AND (archived_at IS NULL) AND (status <> 'skipped'::ref_status))

refs_status_content_chk.name: refs_status_content_chk
refs_status_content_chk.value: ((content_id IS NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['inbox'::ref_status, 'selected'::ref_status, 'skipped'::ref_status]))) OR ((content_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['production'::ref_status, 'posted'::ref_status, 'evaluating'::ref_status])))

public.tag_counts.name: tag_counts
public.tag_counts.definition: SELECT tag, count(*)::integer AS uses FROM ( SELECT unnest(refs.tags) AS tag FROM refs WHERE refs.archived_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT unnest(contents.tags) AS unnest FROM contents WHERE contents.archived_at IS NULL) t GROUP BY tag

public.audio_usage.name: audio_usage
public.audio_usage.definition: SELECT id AS audio_id, (( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM refs r WHERE r.audio_id = a.id AND r.archived_at IS NULL))::integer AS ref_count, (( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM contents c WHERE c.audio_id = a.id AND c.archived_at IS NULL))::integer AS content_count, ( SELECT max(COALESCE(( SELECT max(p.posted_at) AS max FROM posts p WHERE p.content_id = c.id), c.created_at)) AS max FROM contents c WHERE c.audio_id = a.id AND c.archived_at IS NULL) AS last_used_at FROM audios a

public.content_scores.name: content_scores
public.content_scores.definition: SELECT id AS content_id, COALESCE(final_rating::numeric, ( SELECT avg(s.rating) AS avg FROM snapshots s JOIN posts p ON p.id = s.post_id WHERE p.content_id = c.id AND s.status = 'done'::snapshot_status AND s.rating IS NOT NULL)) AS score FROM contents c WHERE archived_at IS NULL

public.content_metrics.name: content_metrics
public.content_metrics.definition: SELECT p.content_id, sum(ls.views) AS views, sum(ls.likes) AS likes, sum(ls.comments) AS comments, sum(ls.saves) AS saves, sum(ls.shares) AS shares, sum(ls.follower_delta) AS follower_delta FROM posts p JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.id, s.post_id, s.checkpoint, s.due_at, s.status, s.views, s.likes, s.comments, s.saves, s.shares, s.follower_delta, s.reach, s.avg_watch_seconds, s.retention_pct, s.profile_visits, s.rating, s.notes, s.filled_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM snapshots s WHERE s.post_id = p.id AND s.status = 'done'::snapshot_status ORDER BY s.due_at DESC, s.checkpoint DESC LIMIT 1) ls ON true GROUP BY p.content_id

public.source_stats.name: source_stats
public.source_stats.definition: SELECT sa.id AS source_account_id, count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.archived_at IS NULL)::integer AS ref_count, count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.archived_at IS NULL AND (r.status = ANY (ARRAY['selected'::ref_status, 'production'::ref_status, 'posted'::ref_status, 'evaluating'::ref_status])))::integer AS selected_count, count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.archived_at IS NULL AND r.content_id IS NOT NULL)::integer AS produced_count, ( SELECT avg(cs.score) AS avg FROM content_scores cs WHERE (cs.content_id IN ( SELECT r2.content_id FROM refs r2 WHERE r2.source_account_id = sa.id AND r2.content_id IS NOT NULL))) AS avg_score FROM source_accounts sa LEFT JOIN refs r ON r.source_account_id = sa.id GROUP BY sa.id
